This is the 3-line 2020 form: a single contrib_all cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply and the whole published total is itemized. Column alignment across the two half-sheets was independently corroborated, not assumed: Lynn Wood appears at rows 2 and 6 against the same address (2490 Wall Ave), and rows 12-15 are four related entities all at 895 Wall Ave at 100.00 each.

itemized.notes: James Harrison Harvey, Commission Seat C, 2020 cycle; 4 pages: p14 cover, p15 FORM B (expenditures), p16-17 FORM A (contributions). PAGE ORDER IS NOT FORM ORDER - Form B is bound before Form A. THE SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE: **Form A is one wide sheet SPLIT ACROSS TWO SCANNED PAGES** - p16 holds only the Date and Name-of-Contributor columns (the right side runs off the sheet edge; the title crops mid-word at 'Form A: C'), and p17 holds only the Address and Amount columns (its title resumes 'ampaign Financial Report 2020 / d Report of Contributions'). The filer hand-numbered them '1 of 2' and '2 of 2' in the lower right. They are ONE table: 21 data rows plus 2 printed blank rows on each half, 1:1 aligned, and the alignment is corroborated by content (Lynn Wood at rows 2 and 6 against the same 2490 Wall Ave address; rows 12-15 four entities all at 895 Wall Ave, 100.00 each) as well as by the printed grid pitch. Every contribution row is anchored to p17 because that is where its AMOUNT is printed; p16's frame is carried for provenance only. Form B on p15 is a ROTATED LANDSCAPE sheet (axis 'x'). PRIVACY: p17's column is headed 'Address' and prints full donor STREET addresses - only city and state are carried here, never the street, per PRIVACY.md; where the filer wrote a parenthetical instead of an address, city/state are blank because the FILER left them empty, not because the county redacted anything (no redaction bars on this filing). Form B has a City column that the itemized schema has no slot for; the two non-Ogden/odd values are noted on their rows. The cover's own two filer errors are already recorded in the stated-totals cache and are unchanged here: the 'October 20 - Oct 27' box is ticked although the clerk RECEIVED stamp is JAN 05 2021 (this is the January final report), and the candidate signature is dated '5 Jan 2020' / '1/5/20', a year typo for 2021. Officeholder-account caveat: the cover's 'Totals from Last Report' column is EMPTY on all three lines, so this report is not opened from a prior cycle and both schedules are whole-cycle, which is why both sides are 'exact' rather than 'period-exact'.
